passages.text: Considered as M. quadrivalvis var. leptocarpa by Barneby (1991), but segregated as a distinct species by Grether (2000). None of the other infraspecific taxa assigned to M. quadrivalvis by Barneby (1991) occur in Bolivia. Mimosa candollei is a widespread and weedy ruderal along roadsides and in abandoned pastures across much of seasonally dry South America.

passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Mimosa candollei R.Grether.
The native range of this species is S. Mexico to Tropical America. It is a subshrub or climbing shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome. It is used as a medicine.
